mapper.select: SELECT FIRST_CAL.USER_NO, FIRST_CAL.USER_ID, FIRST_CAL.USER_CODE, FIRST_CAL.USER_PHONE, FIRST_CAL.USER_NM, FIRST_CAL.FIRM_NM, FIRST_CAL.FIRM_ID, FIRST_CAL.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, REG_DATETIME, FIRM_PERIOD, SECTORS, BUSINESS_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT FIRST_CAL.SHOP_TYPE) AS SHOP_NUM, -- 중복제외 쇼핑몰 수 MIN(FIRST_CAL.SHOP_REGIST_DATE) AS SHOP_REGIST_DATE, -- 등록기간이 가장 오래된 쇼핑몰 TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH,MIN(FIRST_CAL.SHOP_REGIST_DATE),DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) SHOP_REGIST_MONTH FROM ( SELECT CU.USER_NO, CU.USER_ID, CU.USER_CODE, CU.USER_PHONE, CU.USER_NM, CU.FIRM_NM, CU.FIRM_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CU.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FIRM_SETUP_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(CU.REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DATETIME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, CU.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS FIRM_PERIOD, (SELECT CS.SEC_NAME FROM CBCI_SECTOR CS WHERE CS.SEC_NO = CU.SECTORS) AS SECTORS, (SELECT CB.TYPE_NAME FROM CBCI_BIZTYPE CB WHERE CB.TYPE_NO = CU.BUSINESS_TYPE) AS BUSINESS_TYPE, CA.SHOP_TYPE, IF(CA.SHOP_REGIST_DATE IS NULL OR TRIM(CA.SHOP_REGIST_DATE) = '', DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(CA.SHOP_REGIST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS SHOP_REGIST_DATE FROM CBCI_USER CU LEFT JOIN CBCI_ACCOUNT CA ON CA.USER_NO = CU.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST MUR ON MUR.user_code = CA.USER_CODE WHERE CU.USER_NO = ${USER_NO} AND CA.DEL_YN <> 'Y' -- 계정 삭제 여부, * 선정산 신청한 아이디만 골라서 가져오는거 추가 필요 AND (CU.WITHDRAW_YN = 'N' OR CU.WITHDRAW_YN IS NULL) -- AND CU.MONEYBANK_YN = 'Y' -- 선정산 신청여부 AND CA.SHOP_TYPE IN (${request_shop}) ) FIRST_CAL

SELECT SSA_T.MSQ, SSA_T.MSV, SSA_T.MSA, SSA_T.MSP_SUM, SSA_T.MSP_COUNT, SSA_T.MPR, SSA_T.MDP FROM ( SELECT COUNT(SSA.ORDER_NO) as MSQ,
(select IFNULL(SUM(ORDER_AMOUNT),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSV,
(select IFNULL(SUM(PAYMENT_AMOUNT),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSV,
(select IFNULL(SUM(SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT),0) from SHOP_SETTLEMENT_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLEMENT_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSA,
(select IFNULL(SUM(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_AMOUNT),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSA,
(select IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE,ADDDATE(DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY))),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_SUM,
(select IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE,ADDDATE(DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 2 DAY))),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_SUM,
(select IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(CONFIRM_DATE,ADDDATE(DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 2 DAY))),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND CONFIRM_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_SUM,
(select IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SETTLE_COMPLETE_DATE,ADDDATE(DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 2 DAY))),0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLE_COMPLETE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_SUM,
(select COUNT(SHOP_ID) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_COUNT,
(select COUNT(SHOP_ID) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND CONFIRM_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_COUNT,
(select COUNT(SHOP_ID) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND SETTLE_COMPLETE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MSP_COUNT,
(select IFNULL(SUM(seller_discounts_amount + shopping_mall_discount_amount)/sum(order_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MPR,
(select IFNULL(SUM(seller_discounts_amount + shopping_mall_discount_amount)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MPR,
(select IFNULL(SUM(product_instant_discount_amount+product_discount_coupon_amount+product_purchase_discount_amount+seller_discount_coupon_amount+seller_purchase_discount_amount+seller_discounts_amount+seller_purchase_discount_type)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MPR,
(select IFNULL(SUM(discount_amount)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID=#{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MPR,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(DELIVERED_DATE, ADDDATE(PAID_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY)))/COUNT(SHOP_ID),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID} AND DELIVERED_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS MDP FROM SHOP_SALES_API SSA WHERE SSA.SHOP_TYPE = #{SHOP_TYPE} AND SSA.SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') ) AS SSA_T;

SELECT USER_NO, SEQ, IFNULL(PRIZM_GRADE, '-') AS PRIZM_GRADE, IFNULL(PRIZM_SCORE, '-') AS PRIZM_SCORE, IFNULL(BUSINESS_PERIOD, '-') AS BUSINESS_PERIOD, IFNULL(OPERATING_PERIOD, '-') AS OPERATING_PERIOD, IFNULL(SHOP_COUNT, '-') AS SHOP_COUNT, IFNULL(SKU_COUNT, '-') AS SKU_COUNT, IFNULL(B2B_OPERATING_PERIOD, '-') AS B2B_OPERATING_PERIOD, IFNULL(MONTH_SALES_VALUE, '-') AS MONTH_SALES_VALUE, IFNULL(MONTH_SALES_COUNT, '-') AS MONTH_SALES_COUNT, IFNULL(CAL_PRICE, '-') AS CAL_PRICE, IFNULL(CAL_RATE, '-') AS CAL_RATE, IFNULL(B2B_SALES_GROWTH_RATE, '-') AS B2B_SALES_GROWTH_RATE, IFNULL(MONTH_SETTLE_VALUE, '-') AS MONTH_SETTLE_VALUE, IFNULL(ORDER_SETTLE_RATE, '-') AS ORDER_SETTLE_RATE, IFNULL(ORDER_SETTLE_PERIOD, '-') AS ORDER_SETTLE_PERIOD, IFNULL(SUM_CAL_PRE_AMOUNT, '-') AS SUM_CAL_PRE_AMOUNT, IFNULL(CUSTOM_COUNT, '-') AS CUSTOM_COUNT, IFNULL(RETURN_RATE, '-') AS RETURN_RATE, IFNULL(CUSTOM_SATISFACTION, '-') AS CUSTOM_SATISFACTION, IFNULL(SHOP_GRADE, '-') AS SHOP_GRADE, IFNULL(inquiry_response_rate, '-') AS inquiry_response_rate, IFNULL(sales_concentration, '-') AS sales_concentration, IFNULL(operating_profit_rate, '-') AS operating_profit_rate, IFNULL(ship_days, '-') AS ship_days, IFNULL(PERSON_CREDIT_SCORE, '-') AS PERSON_CREDIT_SCORE, IFNULL(OVERDUE, '-') AS OVERDUE, IFNULL(default, '-') AS default, IFNULL(TAX_FULL_PAYMENT, '-') AS TAX_FULL_PAYMENT, IFNULL(INPUT_DATE, '-') AS INPUT_DATE FROM CBCI_PRIZM_RESULT WHERE USER_NO = ${USER_NO}
AND SEQ = #{SEQ} AND DATE_FORMAT(INPUT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{APPROVAL_DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY INPUT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRIZM_PCS_RESULT ( mbid, user_code, prizm_grade, prizm_score, business_period, operating_period, shop_count, monthly_sales_value, monthly_sales_quantity, monthly_settlement_amount, monthly_settlement_period, monthly_settlement_to_sales_rate, monthly_promotion_rate, monthly_delivery_period, monthly_return_rate, cb_score_current, cb_score_rank, cb_score_change_rate, input_date ) VALUES ( #{ID}, #{USER_CODE}, #{PRIZM_GRADE}, #{PRIZM_SCORE}, #{BUSINESS_PERIOD}, #{OPERATING_PERIOD}, #{SHOP_COUNT}, #{MSV}, #{MSQ}, #{MSA}, #{MSP}, #{MSTSR}, #{MPR}, #{MDP}, #{MRR}, #{CB_SCORE}, #{CB_SCORE_RANK}, #{CB_SCORE_CHANGE_RATE}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT ppr.prizm_grade ,ppr.prizm_score ,ppr.business_period ,ppr.operating_period ,ppr.shop_count ,left(ppr.monthly_sales_value, length(ppr.monthly_sales_value)-3) as monthly_sales_value ,ppr.monthly_sales_quantity ,left(ppr.monthly_settlement_amount, length(ppr.monthly_settlement_amount)-3) as monthly_settlement_amount ,ppr.monthly_settlement_period ,ppr.monthly_settlement_to_sales_rate ,ppr.monthly_promotion_rate ,ppr.monthly_delivery_period ,ppr.monthly_return_rate ,ppr.cb_score_current ,ppr.cb_score_rank ,ppr.cb_score_change_rate ,input_date FROM PRIZM_PCS_RESULT ppr WHERE ppr.mbid = #{mbid}

SELECT CA.USER_NO, CA.USER_CODE, CA.SHOP_TYPE, CC.CODE_NM, CA.SHOP_ID, CC.INPUT_DATETIME, CASE WHEN CA.SHOP_TYPE = 1 THEN '99991231' WHEN CA.SHOP_TYPE = 2 THEN (SELECT MIN(DATE_FORMAT(CGG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE,'%Y%m%d')) from CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG WHERE CA.SHOP_ID = CGG.SHOP_ID) WHEN CA.SHOP_TYPE = 3 THEN (SELECT MIN(DATE_FORMAT(CAG.ITEM_REGIST_DATE,'%Y%m%d')) from CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CA.SHOP_ID = CAG.SHOP_ID) WHEN CA.SHOP_TYPE = 4 THEN (SELECT MIN(DATE_FORMAT(CSG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE,'%Y%m%d')) from CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CA.SHOP_ID = CSG.SHOP_ID) WHEN CA.SHOP_TYPE = 11 THEN (SELECT MIN(DATE_FORMAT(CCG.CREATED_DATE,'%Y%m%d')) from CBCI_COUPANG_GOODS CCG WHERE CA.SHOP_ID = CCG.SHOP_ID) WHEN CA.SHOP_TYPE = 14 THEN (SELECT MIN(DATE_FORMAT(CNG.PRODUCT_REG_DATE,'%Y%m%d')) from CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CA.SHOP_ID = CNG.SHOP_ID) END AS PRODUCT_SHOP_REGDATE FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA RIGHT JOIN CBCI_CODE CC ON CC.CODE_ID = CA.SHOP_TYPE WHERE CA.USER_CODE = #{USER_CODE} AND CA.DEL_YN !='Y' AND CA.SHOP_TYPE NOT IN (1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS( mbid, fee_rate, payment_rate, sales_limit_per_case, input_date ) VALUES ( #{ID}, '1.2', '80', '3000000', now() );
